text: I received a request from Spirit of York Distillery Co., located at 12 Trinity Street, advising that in order to obtain a “By The Glass” Manufacturer's Limited Liquor Sales Licence, a resolution from the local Municipal Council is required.

City Council on April 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council advise the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario of its support of the application from Spirit of York Distillery Co., 12 Trinity Street, for a Manufacturer's Limited Liquor Sales Licence for sales by the glass.
